verdict.rationale: The docs claim you can ask Ari "why spending went up," which is an explanation of a period-over-period variance, not just a flag. Ari also proactively "tells you what changed" and traces numbers back to their source lines. But no documented feature explains budget-to-actual variance, shows how explanations are structured (drivers, line-item breakdown), or offers hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actual variance explanation, documented variance-driver breakdown or commentary output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance rather than only flagging it

citations.quote: Ask it whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts.
keeps one model of the company current, and tells you what changed before you ask.
Each one prints its lineage back to the source line.
